blocks.x: IoT, Twin & Robotics for Power Generation & Grid — sensing, simulating, acting — the operations stack that turns physical assets into self-correcting systems applied to the power generation & grid operating unit of Energy & Utilities.

Grid operators balance physics, markets and regulation in real time: forecasting under intermittency, substation reliability, flexibility orchestration and CIP-grade security. The telemetry-to-decision loop is the core competency of the transition era.

items: Transformers/breakers lack condition telemetry; failures unscheduled.
Renewable/demand forecasts legacy; imbalance and curtailment climb.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Industrial IoT & Sensor Fabric, Robotics & Autonomous Systems Integration, Computer Vision & Edge AI from the IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Forecasting and dispatch, Asset condition management, DER/flexibility orchestration) on BI & Analytics Platform and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — NERC CIP among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Facilities that run themselves — BMS/IoT fusion, energy optimization and city-scale platforms.
Sense everything that matters — retrofit-friendly sensor fabric with governed telemetry.
Simulate before you cut steel — plant, fleet and product twins with governed physics and data.
